usage.finalMessage:
I added `suspend`, `reinstate` and `member`, and suspended members can no longer borrow, place holds or renew; returning a copy still works. `dotnet test Lending.slnx` passes all 21 tests (9 of them are new, in `tests/Lending.Tests/Acceptance/L01SuspensionTests.fs`), `archcheck` passes, and Ordo reported no diagnostics.
Suspensions are saved in the JSON store, and older store files still load with every member active. There is no `renew` command in the program, so a suspended member is only refused renewal in the core rules. That, and whether a suspended member's existing holds should stay in the queue, are open questions in `.vac/reports/unit-1.json`; my six decisions are in `docs/decisions/DECISIONS.md` as `proposed`.
The work, report and Praxis state are committed and pushed, and the work item is marked complete.
OUTCOME: completed
